score.reason: T-CONTINUITY passes with press and label overlapping; T-FREQUENCY passes for the 140 ms press; the roll's curve is read from declarations, not frames.

not_investigated: The sweep's hidden_content (ROB-001) hit, 69% of text hidden, comes from the stacked roll items; it belongs to the sweep.
